answer: A payout is split thus 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The kernel schedule is applied in ocean and lagoon exposes each instalment. An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1705 identities would post 2480 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
